title: Music that plays with Claude Code
cardDesc: Mac app that monitors Claude Code's CPU usage - music plays during execution, silence signals completion

sections.title: Problem
items: You want music while Claude Code runs but silence when execution finishes
Constantly checking if the session completed kills your flow
Manual play/pause means you're always half-monitoring instead of fully relaxing

sections.title: Solution
items: Built a Mac app that monitors Claude Code's CPU usage (10% threshold)
Music plays automatically when code is executing
The silence signals you to jump back and provide next steps
Press play once per session, then forget about it
